title: Introduction to ATAC-Seq data analysis
questions: What are the quality parameters to check for each dataset?
key_points: ATAC-Seq can be used to identify accessible gene promoters and enhancers
Several filters are applied to the reads, such as removing those mapped to mitochondria
Fragment distribution can help determine whether an ATAC-Seq experiment has worked well
